ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.*, u.nickname AS author_name, c.name AS category_name, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.slug AS tag_slug, m.id AS meta_id, m.meta_key, m.meta_value FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN blog_article_tag bat ON a.id = bat.article_id LEFT JOIN blog_tag t ON bat.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN blog_article_meta m ON a.id = m.article_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.is_deleted = 0
